correctness.rationale: The prime-power totient formula gives exactly 7, 9, 14, 18. The integer resultant belongs to the ideal of a polynomial and its translate, so every consecutive-value gcd divides it. An independent exact calculation for all four indices confirmed resultants 53824, 253783, 53824, 253783 and all the stated common residues; exhaustive residues modulo each candidate prime square ruled out every common square, and recovered the listed individual lift digits for 7 and 9. This gives the formulas for all integers, not only the input range of a checker. Reflection n→−n−1 yields the last two profiles; their relevant classes are disjoint from their partners. Each prime indicator has a nonempty proper support, so any period is divisible by its prime; CRT gives each least period. The independent count over all CRT tuples gives the eight frozen frequencies and verifies the 8839 witness.
residual_risks: Only the degree-six layer and shift one are classified. The modular exhaustion is justified by the nonzero integer resultants, not by the integer sample size.
